Sequence integrity checks for quality control

Source: R/qc.R
rb_qc_checks.Rd

Functions to check individual sequences or groups of sequences for common quality issues.

  • rb_check_codons(): Checks coding sequences (COI) for stop codons and frameshifts.

  • rb_check_rrna_integrity(): Checks rRNA sequences (12S, 16S) for abnormal length and the presence of any non-ACGT characters (including alignment gaps and ambiguous IUPAC codes like 'N').

  • rb_check_divergence(): Detects phylogenetically divergent sequences within species/gene groups using MAFFT alignment and FastTree.

Usage

rb_check_codons(
  sequence,
  gene,
  coding_genes = c("COI", "CYTB", "complete_genome", "genome", "multi_marker"),
  genetic_code = "2",
  max_internal_stops = 2L
)

rb_check_rrna_integrity(
  sequence,
  gene,
  rrna_genes = c("12S", "16S"),
  min_length = 100L,
  max_ambiguous_frac = NULL
)

rb_check_divergence(
  data,
  species_col = "species",
  gene_col = "gene",
  sequence_col = "sequence",
  id_col = "unique_code",
  min_seqs = 5,
  outlier_mult = 5,
  outlier_floor = 0.02,
  mafft = "mafft",
  fasttree = "FastTree"
)

Arguments

sequence

A single DNA sequence string.

gene

The gene/marker type (e.g., "COI", "12S", "genome").

coding_genes

Gene types to check for codon issues. Default c("COI").

genetic_code

Genetic code table (default "2" for vertebrate mtDNA).

max_internal_stops

Integer scalar (default 2L). Maximum number of internal stop codons tolerated in the best of the six reading frames before the record is flagged frameshifted. The terminal stop of a complete CDS is not counted. has_stop is set independently whenever any internal stop is present, so lowering this value only tightens the frameshifted flag, not internal_stop.

rrna_genes

Gene types to check for rRNA integrity.

min_length

Minimum expected length for rRNA sequences.

max_ambiguous_frac

Numeric scalar in [0, 1], or NULL (default). Optional exclusion threshold on the proportion of ambiguous (IUPAC) bases among called bases (frac_ambig). When supplied, records with frac_ambig > max_ambiguous_frac receive the ambiguous_excess flag and are excluded from the passing set. When NULL, ambiguity never excludes a record; it is reported only through the informational ambiguous_bases note and the n_ambiguous / frac_ambig metadata columns.

data

A data frame containing sequences and metadata.

species_col, gene_col, sequence_col, id_col

Column names.

min_seqs

Minimum sequences per group for divergence analysis.

outlier_mult

Multiplier for median edge length to find outliers.

outlier_floor

Minimum absolute edge length for outliers.

mafft, fasttree

Paths to external executables.

Value

  • rb_check_codons() returns a data.frame with one row per input sequence:

    has_stop

    Logical. TRUE if the best reading frame contains at least one internal stop codon. NA for non-coding markers.

    frameshifted

    Logical. TRUE iif n_internal_stops exceeds max_internal_stops. NA for non-coding markers.

    n_internal_stops

    Integer. Internal stop count in the best frame, excluding a terminal stop. NA for non-coding markers.

    best_frame

    Integer. Index of the selected frame among those evaluated (see Details). NA for non-coding markers.

    coding_strand

    Character. "F" if the best frame is on the supplied strand, "R" if on its reverse complement. NA for non-coding markers.

    frame_complete

    Logical. Whether the cleaned sequence length is a multiple of three (informational only). NA for non-coding markers.

    codon_check_run

    Logical tri-state

    NA = check not applicable (non-coding markers); FALSE = attempted but could not complete; TRUE = completed. A FALSE value raises the check_failed QC flag.

  • rb_check_rrna_integrity() returns a data.frame with one row per input sequence:

    has_gaps

    Logical. TRUE if any gap character or IUPAC code is present. Informational; does not exclude a record. NA for non-rRNA markers.

    has_short

    Logical. TRUE if n_base is below min_length. NA for non-rRNA markers.

    n_gap_chars

    Integer. Count of - and . characters.

    n_ambiguous

    Integer. Count of IUPAC ambiguity codes.

    n_base

    Integer. Biological length, n_acgt + n_ambiguous.

    frac_ambig

    Numeric. n_ambiguous / n_base; NA when n_base is 0.

    max_gap_run

    Integer. Length of the longest contiguous gap run.

  • rb_check_divergence() returns data with a div_result column.

Details

Note: This function relies on shell pipes (|) to stream MAFFT output into FastTree. While this works on Unix-like systems, Windows users may need to ensure their shell environment (e.g., Git Bash or WSL) is properly configured, or install MSYS2, as the default cmd.exe may not support these pipes.

Translation is attempted in six frames: three forward offsets and three on the reverse complement. The frame with the fewest internal stops is selected, so records deposited in reverse orientation are handled correctly. Frames shorter than three bases are skipped; for very short inputs best_frame therefore indexes the reduced set, and coding_strand is the more reliable identifier.

Alignment padding (-, .) and whitespace are removed before translation; IUPAC ambiguity codes are retained and resolved with Biostrings::translate(if.fuzzy.codon = "solve"), so an ambiguous codon does not abort the check. A stop in the final codon is treated as a legitimate termination and excluded from the internal count.

Stops are those of genetic_code, which defaults to "2" (vertebrate mitochondrial).

Gap characters and ambiguity codes are reported separately because they mean different things. - and . may be alignment padding, a genuine deletion relative to other sequences, or undetermined bases; these cannot be distinguished from the character alone, so nothing is stripped or altered here. IUPAC codes represent real base-calling uncertainty and are retained.

Neither condition excludes a record by default. Presence of gap or ambiguous characters is recorded in has_gaps and surfaced as the informational sequence_gap / ambiguous_bases notes by rb_compile_qc_flags(). Only has_short is excluding, and it is assessed on biological length so that alignment padding cannot inflate a short record past the threshold.

See also

Other quality control: rb_qc_pipeline, rb_qc_screening

Examples

# Non-coding markers: check not applicable
rb_check_codons("ACGTACGTACGT", gene = "12S")
#>   has_stop frameshifted n_internal_stops best_frame coding_strand
#> 1       NA           NA               NA         NA          <NA>
#>   frame_complete codon_check_run
#> 1             NA              NA

# Coding marker: check completes, length is a multiple of three
res <- rb_check_codons(strrep("ACGT", 30), gene = "COI")
res$codon_check_run
#> [1] TRUE
res$frame_complete
#> [1] TRUE
res$coding_strand
#> [1] "F"

#' # Clean 200 bp reference
rb_check_rrna_integrity(strrep("ACGT", 50), gene = "12S")
#>   has_gaps has_short n_gap_chars n_ambiguous n_base frac_ambig max_gap_run
#> 1    FALSE     FALSE           0           0    200          0           0

# One ambiguity code: informational, still passing
s <- strrep("ACGT", 50)
s <- paste0(substr(s, 1, 100), "S", substr(s, 101, 200))
rb_check_rrna_integrity(s, gene = "12S")
#>   has_gaps has_short n_gap_chars n_ambiguous n_base  frac_ambig max_gap_run
#> 1     TRUE     FALSE           0           1    201 0.004975124           0

# Padding does not count toward biological length
padded <- paste0(strrep("A", 90), strrep("-", 50))
rb_check_rrna_integrity(padded, gene = "12S")$has_short   # TRUE
#> [1] TRUE
